request.description: ADMIN only. Body must be { "isActive": boolean }. Deactivates via soft-delete flags.
ADMIN only. Body must be { "role": "CANDIDATE" | "RECRUITER" | "ADMIN" }. Cannot change own role.

request.description: Any authenticated role (typically CANDIDATE paying for own attempt). Zod: assessmentId UUID, amountInCents int >= 50. Returns { url, sessionId, payment }. Pay at `url` with test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.

request.description: PUBLIC (no Bearer token). Stripe signs the raw body; server verifies signature via STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Test with: stripe listen --forward-to localhost:5000/api/v1/payments/webhook. Marks payment PAID/FAILED idempotently.
Server-side Stripe retrieve + reconcile. Marks PAID if Stripe says paid. Use after returning from Checkout success_url.
Lists current user payments with assessment titles.
